topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints create a trade-off between immediate and time-tagged services, impacting power allocation. Dynamic power allocation based on buffer status and channel conditions optimizes resource use, minimizing interference and ensuring QoS. Integrating machine learning models and queueing theory enhances predictive capabilities and performance analysis.
reference_context: SatCom systems face trade-offs between capacity, latency, and power due to on-board storage constraints, requiring dynamic resource allocation strategies.
